verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs cover instrumentation in both a Python SDK (platforms/python tracing docs: auto-instrumented AI libraries, `set_conversation_id()`, integration options) and a JavaScript/Node SDK (platforms/javascript/guides/node: 'As of SDK version 11.0.0…' auto-instrumentation). The homepage also frames the SDK as the drop-in instrumentation path. missing for 10: explicit TypeScript mention, evidence of general (non-AI-agent) tracing instrumentation in both SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Python/JS SDKs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: Supported AI libraries are instrumented automatically when their packages are installed.
Use `set_conversation_id()` so every AI span in a chat session shares the same `gen_ai.conversation.id`.
As of SDK version `11.0.0`, Sentry auto-instruments the most popular AI SDKs and frameworks out of the box
Drop in the [SDK](https://sentry.io/platforms/). No agents to install.
